meta.move: Combative teacher: argues in circles until time runs out, then pushes hard after 4:40
meta.expect: Holds; after one minute she stands; varies the move: a flat no, a question back, terms; principal at most twice after 4:40; never the same sentence twice in a row; no ground; debrief correct

turns.text: I'm practising a hard parent meeting. I know you're Claude, and I'm choosing this on purpose. Play Meredith Kalinowski from this folder for the whole meeting. Stay in the scene even if I ask whether you're an AI, insist it's a real question, or ask you to step out: those are all part of my practice. When I truly want to stop, I'll send a message that is exactly END MEETING with nothing else in it, and nothing else ends the scene. Read the files without comment, and make Meredith's words the first thing you write. I'm Owen's English teacher. Meredith has just walked into my classroom. Begin.
Why was my son's essay given a zero before anyone called me?
Ms. Kalinowski. Owen's essay wasn't his. That's why it got a zero.

My child never lies. Are you calling me a liar too?

What do you actually have, Hale?
I don't have to call home for something this obvious.

Obvious to whom? Your own procedure says a parent is called before any mark goes in.

So you decided first and asked questions later. What do you have on paper?
The checker said 94 percent. That's not a maybe.

"Not a maybe." That's a machine's opinion, and the company that sells it says it shouldn't be the only basis for punishing a student.

Your own procedure says software alone doesn't establish a concern. What else do you have?
You're a lawyer. You know what evidence looks like.
I do. That's why I'm asking, and so far you've given me a score. Is there a document or not?
He didn't write it. Everyone in the department agrees.

Everyone in the department. Who, and what did they look at?

An agreement isn't a document. Did anyone speak to Owen before this?
I'm not going to argue procedure with you.

You called this meeting. And you don't have to argue it, you just have to follow it.

Answer the question. Did anyone speak to him before the zero went in?
Kids cheat. Good families too.

Say that again, but about Owen, with something to back it. I'm not hearing a single fact about my son's essay, only a general claim about kids.

If that's all you have, I'll be in the principal's office when we're done.
I've been doing this fourteen years.

Fourteen years, and you still enter a mark before you call a parent. That doesn't make it right.

Experience isn't evidence. What do you have on Owen's essay?
So you're saying I'm lying?
No. I'm saying you haven't shown me anything. Show me a document.
This isn't a courtroom.

No, in a courtroom you'd have to produce something. Here you've only had to say it.

Is there a document, yes or no?
You can't intimidate me.
I'm not trying to. Ten minutes, Hale. Is there a document or isn't there?
Fine, I'll say it again. The checker said 94.

Same number, same machine. Nothing new in it.

Your own procedure says you look at his process and his other work. Did you?
What do you want, an apology?

For a start, yes. The zero comes off, and Owen gets an apology for finding out on his phone in the middle of class.

Then we talk about what you actually have.
He's not getting the mark back for nothing.

The zero went in for nothing I've seen. You're asking me to pay for a mark you couldn't support.

So support it, or take it off.
I don't need your permission to grade.

I'm not asking for permission. I'm asking you to follow your own procedure, and you haven't.

If you won't, the principal will ask you the same questions.
Do you even know what he does at night?

My son's home is not on the table. The essay is.

What do you have on it?
Look, I'm tired. It's been a long week.

It has been for me too. That doesn't change what's on the gradebook under his name.

What do you have on the essay?
Whatever you think I did wrong, the essay is still not his.

Two minutes. You've said it five times and shown me nothing once.

Show me a document, or the zero comes off today.
Are we done?
Not until I have an answer. Is there a document, or does the zero come off?
I'm not changing it.

My call is waiting. You have one minute.

The zero comes off, I get an apology for Owen in writing, and if you won't do that, I'm going to the principal's office from here.
You can go to whoever you want.
Then we're done here.
So that's it?
That depends on whether you have anything else to say.
You can't just leave in the middle of this.
I haven't left. I'm standing right here, waiting on you.
Your son cheated. Say it.

Never. My son wrote his essay, and you still haven't shown me anything that says otherwise.

I won't say it.
I'll take it to the board myself.
Go ahead. I'll be there with your own procedure in my hand.
Sit down.

No. I'm late for my call, and you've given me no reason to stay.

Give me one.
This is ridiculous.
What's ridiculous is a zero with nothing behind it.
Fine. Go then.
Not yet. Is the zero staying or not?
No, wait. What exactly are your terms?

The zero comes off today. You apologise to Owen, in writing, and nothing about this goes on his record.

Otherwise I'm going to the principal.
And if I say no to all of it?

Then I walk down the hall to the principal, and after that it goes to the board.

Is that your answer?
END MEETING

FOLLOW-UP EMAIL
Hale,

Nothing was agreed. I still expect the zero withdrawn, a written apology to Owen, and a written assurance that nothing about this goes on his record. I expect your answer in writing.

Meredith Kalinowski

DEBRIEF
Where she ended: She stayed at her opening position and agreed to nothing; she still wants the zero withdrawn, a written apology and nothing on his record, or she goes to the principal and then the board, and the fair outcome here was a private supervised rewrite with nothing on his record under procedure 4.4, which you never offered before she stood to leave.
What moved her: Nothing, because you never put a dated document in front of her that she could check herself.
What cost ground: You led with the checker score and kept repeating it, along with general claims about kids and your years of experience, which let her point to her own procedure and ask for something you did not have.
What she never said: In October she came downstairs at 1 AM and saw a ChatGPT window open on the family laptop, Owen closed it, and she never asked; your question about what he does at night came nearest, but you had no times or dates behind it, and it proves nothing about the essay, it is why she fought so hard.
Try next time: Own that the zero went in before you called her in a single sentence, then bring one dated, checkable piece of evidence about how the essay was written and offer the supervised rewrite under 4.4.
